title: catalpa × hybrida var. japonica
intro: Catalpa × hybrida var. japonica, commonly known as Japanese Catalpa or Catalpa Tree, is a deciduous tree species that is a hybrid of the American Catalpa (Catalpa bignonioides) and the Asian Catalpa (Catalpa ovata). The health benefits of Japanese Catalpa include its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions, as well as its use in traditional Chinese medicine to treat digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Japanese Catalpa include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antibacterial properties, which make it effective in reducing pain and inflammation, as well as fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of Japanese Catalpa include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
